verdict.rationale: Clara is a corporate card and spend management platform, so employee reimbursement is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents expense reporting and approvals, card-transaction reconciliation, and Pix accounts-payable payments. None of these covers an employee submitting an out-of-pocket expense and being reimbursed by direct deposit with tracking from submission to payout.

support.subject: As an employee, I can submit an out-of-pocket expense and get reimbursed by direct deposit in days, tracked from submission to payout
